statement: Business meaning never derives authority from a storage or wire representation.
A source-system class, provider offer, deployed occurrence, access surface and connector are five different identities.
A connector capability claim does not prove successful extraction from a particular occurrence.
A governed cut must identify exact population/time/schema/provenance and residual uncertainty; it is not equivalent to source truth.
Semantic values and logical shapes own equality/grain/time/uncertainty; physical formats own representation only.
Catalog metadata and lineage may describe sources and transformations but never become semantic owners by observation.
Provenance records derivation; it is neither truth nor independent assurance.
Telemetry records technical observations; business events and accepted outcomes retain separate identities.
A reusable analytical method is not the operated analytical study that selects data, assumptions, stopping and evaluation.
Analytical result, recommendation, judgment, authorization, effect execution and accepted outcome are distinct lifecycle facts.
Policy evaluation is separate from authentication, policy authorship, accountable authorization occurrence and effect enforcement.
Workflow coordinates work; it does not own source data semantics, analytical method semantics or external effect authority.
Compensation is a separately modeled business action and is never presumed to restore arbitrary prior state.
The planner/synthesizer may search and compose existing contracts but may not invent missing semantic authority.
Authority adjudication freezes accepted declarations; it does not perform target lowering.
Compiler lowering is deterministic over locked inputs; unresolved judgment must refuse or return to planning/adjudication.
AppRelease is a versioned artifact set, not an environment binding or running occurrence.
Successful boot proves neither business correctness nor vertical acceptance.
Producer-generated evidence cannot substitute for independent appraisal when independence is a gate.
Structural composition across products is not executed system acceptance.
Provider implementation success cannot transfer semantic ownership from the abstract contract owner.
Same-campaign implementations may support differential engineering evidence but never count as independent implementations.
A vertical solution pack composes horizontal products and may add vertical vocabulary/rules/acceptance; it may not fork horizontal semantics without an explicit boundary revision.
AI/ML is an optional method/provider family; the architecture must remain valid when AI capabilities are removed.
Finite source, product, method, data-shape or industry registries are open-world candidate universes, not completeness proofs.
Every material change must identify affected claims, contracts, builds, bindings, qualifications and accepted systems rather than silently inheriting prior validity.
Data retention, deletion and recall obligations must propagate through governed cuts, derived representations and downstream effects with residuals explicit.
Resource budgets are finite declared constraints; they are not physical reservations unless a runtime binding proves reservation semantics.
An API/schema/event envelope is a representation of an interaction or event contract, never the semantic contract itself.
A migration or upcast relation must be directional and loss-aware; successful conversion does not establish semantic equivalence.
Identity, event order, workflow order, transaction order, observation time and recording time are distinct coordinates unless an exact contract proves a relation.
Human accessibility, recoverability and appeal are application/system obligations, not presentation decoration.
